say:1:1432502001:1.text: My husband's secret treasure fund—hidden right under my nose!
say:1:1432502001:1.source_cn: 我丈夫背着我偷偷藏起来的小金库！

say:1:1432502001:1.female: My husband's secret treasure fund—hidden right under my nose!

say:2:1432502002:1.text: I swear, I'll dig three feet down if that's what it takes!

say:3:1432502003:1.text: Argh! Still no sign of it! Alright, that's it. Tonight, when he sneaks off to hide the money, I'm catching him red-handed!
